title: Which of the traffic head's two beliefs costs beside BBRv3 and Westwood, validation links
description: On the test links, net2s whose beliefs come from net1 v7's traffic head lost about 0.11 beside BBRv3 and Westwood, which no training data had (exp-traffic-head-test-309). Refitting the head beside the 15 other stock controllers did not stop it calling BBRv3 copies: with the fixed rule observed on validation links, 13% to 15% of steps from 20 s on, against 10% to 11% for the head of 306; Westwood fell from 0.16 to 0.08 (exp-traffic-head-v7-stock-312). That rate looks too small for the loss, so this splits it. Round 29's rules with beliefs from the head of 306 (exp-traffic-head-v7-agg-306): both (net2-v7hpn, t 0.5, tq 0.5); only the belief in a stock flow, the belief in copies sharpened at 0.99 so that it never acts (net2-v7hpn-p); only the belief in copies, the stock one at 0.99 (net2-v7hpn-q); and both from the refitted head of 312 (net2-v7hpk). Beside round 29's net2 on its own beliefs (net2-v7) and the fixed rule at u = 0.25 (rule-v7). Each has three replicates (round 29's training seeds; the head arms do not use the actor, so these differ only by episode). On the validation links at campaign seed 21: BBRv3 and Westwood from 0 s (60 s), a Cubic flow that started first (60 s), and 2 and 4 copies (30 s). Reading, stated before the results: if net2-v7hpn-p loses at least 0.05 against net2-v7 beside BBRv3 and Westwood and net2-v7hpn-q loses less than 0.02, the loss is the share rule answering a stock flow that is not Cubic, not the head misreading it; the reverse names the belief in copies.
prepare: (cd "$IN/t" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); G="$IN/n/traffic_head.pt"; echo "8ad397a52a7f09fc2b2a136f017d0a52b49a5f0bfcae9f10040d8a015891f2e8  $G" | sha256sum -c; K="$IN/k/traffic_head.pt"; echo "0480ff07899e8e8286e87fdcf02fcedb43c64aac53a09a4b3363e35b21e78092  $K" | sha256sum -c; mkdir -p "$OUT/p"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/rule-v7" "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" --u 0.25; P=(--policy "rule-v7=$OUT/rule-v7/rule-u0.25.onnx"); for s in 1 2 3; do d="$OUT/runs/r29-s$s"; mkdir -p "$d"; cp "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" "$d/net1.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-s$s.actor.pt" "$d/actor.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-s$s.ppo_spec.json" "$d/ppo_spec.json"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7-s$s" "$d" --t 0.5; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7hpn-s$s" "$d" --t 0.5 --tq 0.5 --traffic "$G" --traffic-p; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7hpn-p-s$s" "$d" --t 0.5 --tq 0.99 --traffic "$G" --traffic-p; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7hpn-q-s$s" "$d" --t 0.99 --tq 0.5 --traffic "$G" --traffic-p; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7hpk-s$s" "$d" --t 0.5 --tq 0.5 --traffic "$K" --traffic-p; for a in v7 v7hpn v7hpn-p v7hpn-q v7hpk; do P+=(--policy "net2-$a-s$s=$OUT/p/net2-$a-s$s.onnx"); done; done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 32 ]; RULE_EVAL_FAMILIES=cubic-first:60 experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-held-competitors-60" --split val --family held-competitors --duration-ms 60000 --seed 21 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-held-competitors-60/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-held-competitors-60"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"; rm -rf "$OUT/runs"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart held-competitors-60 copies-30s
